text.aria-label: Title text 'Both ERA5-trained forecasts have a lower probabilistic error than the ENS-trained benchmark up to day 6; beyond that no arm clearly beats climatology'

g.text: Both ERA5-trained forecasts have a lower probabilistic error than the ENS-trained benchmark up to day 6; beyond that no arm clearly beats climatology

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Continuous ranked probability score, points of the generator's capacity (smaller is better), by how many days ahead the forecast is. CRPS: continuous ranked probability score, estimated from nine quantile levels. ERA5: ECMWF's estimate of past weather. ENS: ECMWF's 51-member ensemble weather forecast. Every XGBoost model gets the same weather columns and no calendar or power-history columns. 6 solar farms and 3 wind farms; 53 ENS runs, one every 7 days, July 2025 to June 2026. Intervals come from re-drawing whole months at random and fitting with different random seeds. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval.'
text.tspan: Continuous ranked probability score, points of the generator's capacity (smaller is better), by how many days ahead the forecast is.

CRPS: continuous ranked probability score, estimated from nine quantile levels. ERA5: ECMWF's estimate of past weather. ENS: ECMWF's 51-member ensemble weather forecast. Every XGBoost model gets the same weather columns and no calendar or power-history columns.
6 solar farms and 3 wind farms; 53 ENS runs, one every 7 days, July 2025 to June 2026. Intervals come from re-drawing whole months at random and fitting with different random seeds.
